name: BTP Build Process Automation Agent
description: Builds an SAP Build Process Automation (SBPA) workflow for PO Acknowledgement exception handling. When DOX confidence is low or confirmed values breach tolerance (quantity / date / price), a buyer task is raised with the extracted vs. PO values side-by-side. On approval the workflow calls back the Integration Suite iFlow to post the S/4 confirmation; on rejection it closes the item with a reason.
technology: SAP Build Process Automation, Workzone/My Inbox, BTP Destinations
